episodes.h: TUCKER EXPOSES HUCKABEE??? Israel Ambassador CONDEMNED By Middle East
episodes.blurb: Nick argues the US is mobilizing for an Iran war for Israel while retreating from Minneapolis, and covers Tucker Carlson's interview with Mike Huckabee, calling Israel's right-to-exist claim a pro-Israel playbook.

In live coverage of the State of the Union, Nick argues beforehand that Trump has blown his window and Democrats will take the House, reacts to the speech, then rates it a B or C and calls the Democratic response a class-warfare pitch.

episodes.h: TRUMP CRUSHES SOTU??? Democrats ANNIHILATED By TRUMP
episodes.blurb: Nick admits he was wrong about the State of the Union, liking its combative rhetoric against Democrats while arguing Trump's rhetoric is divorced from governance, then covers US-Iran talks in Switzerland, still leaning toward a US strike.

episodes.h: IRAN TALKS COLLAPSE??? Iran REJECTS US Demands, WAR IMMINENT (FOR REAL)
episodes.blurb: Nick covers the failed Geneva Iran talks, arguing no deal is possible; Ellison's Paramount-Warner Brothers win, which he calls a Zionist media empire; and the Charlie Kirk theories, saying conspiracy content has become engagement farming.

In an emergency Saturday broadcast on the US-Israeli attack on Iran, Nick argues it is a regime-change war for Israel's regional hegemony that air power can't finish, and that Trump voters were misled.
